items.question: What placement is prescribed for the water-gate of those previously mentioned groups?
premises: The water-gate requires a prescribed placement.
This placement concerns those previously mentioned groups.
The speaker undertakes to declare this placement.
items.inference: Therefore the placement of the water-gate for those groups is to be specified.
items.plain_english: I will now declare the placement of the water-gate for them.
